profile.headline: Engineer at Lightfield
profile.summary: Physicist turned software engineer. Now building an AI-native CRM at Lightfield, after a decade on entity resolution at Tamr.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer of Tamr’s real-time, multi-tenant MDM platform. Designed scalable data pipelines and APIs that power critical customer integrations. Spearheaded internal tools and analytics that drive product insight and operational reliability across the platform.

positions.title: Director of DataOps
positions.description: Oversaw delivery and implementation for customers in Tamr’s managed GCP cloud. Drove cross-functional collaboration with DevOps, SRE, and Product to evolve the Tamr Cloud experience. Championed DataOps best practices across the company to improve reliability, scalability, and time to value.

positions.title: DataOps Technical Lead
positions.description: Led implementation of scalable, cloud-based ML pipelines across diverse enterprise environments. Partnered with Product and Engineering to design and ship new features grounded in real-world use cases. Managed and mentored a high-performing team of data engineers and scientists, fostering both technical and career growth.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: Prototyped an interactive analytics platform visualizing racial bias in policing, combining 50M+ records with ML and public data. Demonstrated actionable insights through data storytelling and predictive models.

positions.title: Graduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Analyzed petabyte-scale LHC datasets using distributed computing and custom software pipelines. Contributed to the first ATLAS analysis targeting charged tri-boson production, a rare Standard Model process. Presented results to the ATLAS collaboration and at international physics conferences, helping shape review and visibility of key findings.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Performed Monte Carlo simulation using C/C++ to aid in the study of a new dark matter detector

company.name: Triangle Universities Nuclear Laboratory - Duke University

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Ran a highly parallelized optimization study for the design of a new Free Electron Laser by utilizing supercomputer infrastructure at the National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

honors.description: In my very first year of teaching, I was awarded the honor of most outstanding teaching fellow in the Boston University physics department for the 2010-2011 academic year.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boston University College of Arts and Sciences · May 2011

patents.title: Method and computer program product for producing a record clustering with estimated clustering accuracy metrics with confidence intervals
patents.description: A method is provided for producing a record clustering with estimated accuracy metrics with confidence intervals. These metrics can be used to determine whether a clustering should be accepted as the output of the system, and whether model training is necessary to meet desired clustering accuracy. A collection of test records is used in the process, wherein each test record is a member of a collection of input records.

patents.title: Method of using clusters to train supervised entity resolution in big data
patents.description: Record clustering is performed by learning from verified clusters which are used as the source of training data in a deduplication workflow utilizing supervised machine learning.
